sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)
limitations: Static rule check over the live staleRelevantPaths module, with the expected analyzer derived by parsing the engine's getAnalyzer routing (the authority the private wave-execute alias map mirrors — the map itself is not exported, and copying it here would be the drift this gate prevents).
Plus one differential against a stored leg pin; the legs' own S1-S6 gates re-run per execution.
The routing parser is shape-sensitive by design: an unreadable switch fails R0 rather than passing silently.
